objectives: Count the souls that came into Egypt.
Explain why the brethren named their trade as shepherds.
takeaways: The house of Jacob that came into Egypt was threescore and ten, seventy souls.
Every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians, so naming their trade set Israel apart in Goshen.
The favor Joseph had came through Pharaoh to give them fertile land.
